items.title: Google launches a universal Gemini work agent that can run on Claude instead of Gemini
items.summary: At its Gemini at Work event on October 8, Google Cloud introduced a single Gemini agent that takes a goal rather than step-by-step instructions, then plans, uses tools, and connects to a company's systems to finish the work. It runs inside Gmail, Docs, Sheets, and Calendar (plus Microsoft 365 and Slack), and by default it auto-picks the best model for each task, including Anthropic's Claude models alongside Google's own, with cost caps and per-agent identities for governance. It's rolling out to businesses first; financial-services and legal versions are in preview.
items.whyItMatters: Automatic per-task model routing between providers (not just one vendor's models) is a pattern worth stealing for the Romain/Anna backend — e.g. routing a quick grading or transcript-summary subtask to whichever model is cheapest that hour, instead of hardcoding one API.
